gen-luckiest-guy-gf-scope-one: Scope One has a big x-height and stubby ascenders, a text serif whose counters spill out into the space around them. Luckiest Guy shouts above it in poured, cheerful ink, and the two sound like a loud friend and a patient one.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-slabo-13px: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy bends its single-width strokes like neon tubing, while Slabo 13px stays bookish with its big open counters. One is built to shout; the other is built to be read.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-suwannaphum: Loud, chunky and grinning at the top. Suwannaphum sits underneath as a dignified serif with a tall x-height, so the joke gets a straight-faced editor.
gen-megrim-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab brings a classic, dignified text serif with tall rounded lowercase forms and a gaping c. And Megrim does what it does best up top, a futuristic, fineliner-thin angular line that the body never tries to copy.
gen-megrim-gf-hanuman: Megrim draws angular, futuristic letters with tube-like strokes that never change width, and its c gapes like a bent paperclip. And Hanuman, a refined text serif with a high-waisted lowercase, is happy to stay beneath it.
gen-megrim-gf-kadwa: Kadwa reads classic and editorial, its curves left open. Over a long passage the larger x-height keeps the serif text easy on the eye, while Megrim stays a thin, angular flourish up above.
gen-megrim-gf-noticia-text: Noticia Text is literary and dignified, its curved letters entered through a big visible lead-in. Noticia Text would carry a long passage with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, a steady counterweight to Megrim's angular lines.
gen-megrim-gf-piazzolla: Refined and authoritative, the lowercase here nearly matches its capitals. Piazzolla, a classic serif with a pried-open e, gives Megrim's thin angular strokes and futuristic edge something solid to lean against.
gen-megrim-gf-pridi: Thin, angular and a bit sci-fi, Megrim keeps crossbars as thick as stems. But Pridi, a classic refined text serif with proud small letters and generous curve openings, would read comfortably down a long passage.
gen-megrim-gf-scope-one: Megrim's angular strokes all share one width, like wire. Scope One, a classic serif with a big x-height and stubby ascenders, adds a traditional, refined counterpoint beneath it.
